root_cause.text: The `ttm_bo_access()` function dereferences `bo->resource->mem_type` without first verifying that `bo->resource` is non-NULL, causing a NULL pointer dereference when the buffer object has been evicted and no longer has an associated resource.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a guard `if (!bo->resource)` before the `switch (bo->resource->mem_type)` statement, and the commit message explains that a BO may exist without a resource after eviction, triggering the NULL pointer deref when devcoredump iterates all BOs.
